messages:
Carla M: Heads-up — customer NimbleHealth uploaded a SIG v2.0 into Zendesk and flagged BYOK/KMS questions. They want timeline + POC. Link: https://zendesk.example/ticket/SEC-2026-789. Can security pick an owner? @Devon P
security-bot: Ticket SEC-2026-789 created and queued to security intake (priority: unassigned).
Devon P: I'll take this. Quick clarifying Qs: do they require full customer-managed keys (BYOK) with HSM, or is cloud-KMS integration acceptable? The form's Q12 about "customer key custody" is ambiguous.
Carla M: Sales notes say "BYOK preferred" and they've marked as enterprise. They asked for a short POC on the encryption flow before EOW. Customer contact: secops@nimblehealth.com.
Irene L: I can run the POC for the encryption path. Need a masked/synthetic sample dataset and their network diagram (VPC peering details). If we get materials by Tue we can hit EOW.
Devon P: Two potential blockers to call out: 1) If they insist on HSM-backed keys we may need Private deployment + architecture review. 2) They listed "HSM attestation" — need to confirm which certs they require. @Sam R can you confirm feasibility?
Sam R: We have an established BYOK flow for AWS KMS (CloudHSM) and GCP CMEK; we also have partner attestation options for HSMs (Thales/PartnerX). I'll drop the presales snippet + links into the ticket. Also need expected QPS for the POC (tokens/sec).
Carla M: POC traffic estimate: peak ~50 qps, sustained ~10 qps. They will only provide masked data. NDA may be required for any logs — do we have one on file for them?
Devon P: I'll check NDA status. Action items: Sam -> provide BYOK/HSM wording and proof links by EOD; Irene -> confirm POC infra requirements by Monday; Carla -> request masked sample, network diagram, and confirm NDA. I'll start drafting SIG answers for controls we can assert. Anything that requires Private deployment will be marked "architecture review required".
Carla M: :thumbsup: Marking this high priority on our side. Please set ticket priority to enterprise if you can.
Devon P: Done — Zendesk updated to P1-enterprise and assigned to me. Ticket: https://zendesk.example/ticket/SEC-2026-789 (note: added checklist).
security-bot: Reminder: attach the network diagram and sample schema before marking the design step complete.
Irene L: Will upload the sample infra diagram to the ticket once the customer shares it. Also planning to reuse the BYOK presales kit — https://redwood.docs/byok-presales (will paste excerpts in the ticket).
Sam R: Pasted presales snippet into ticket:
> We support AWS KMS BYOK via CloudHSM and GCP CMEK. For HSM-backed key custody, we partner with Thales/PartnerX for attestation. For Private deployment customers, HSM integration is supported with additional architecture review and SLA.
Carla M: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up after I get the masked data and NDA signed. Tentative check-in Tue 09:00 PST.
Devon P: Sounds good. I'll keep the SIG draft in the ticket for review and ping the thread when ready. /me updates ticket when edits are in.
